text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The other day, Gold City's manager and
I got
together to coordinate her
schedule. However...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Lately, Gold City has been busy every
second of
the day. I imagine it's
physically taxing.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer! I overslept! It's already
past my
reserved time on the machine,
but maybe we can
still get a spot?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well... so much for that idea. There are
no time
slots left.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. Here I am, making you waste
your time
too.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but I'm losing out. It's me who
decided I
could do all this—running and
modeling.
choice_data_list: きっと疲れが溜まってたんだよ
choice_data_list_en: Fatigue must have just caught up with you.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Literally, how can I not even take proper care of myself? I have to get over this fatigue!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: そうやって自分を責めると、尚更疲れるよ
choice_data_list_en: Blaming yourself like that will only wear you out even more.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You're right. I'll only be wasting time if I
spend it
feeling sorry for myself.
choice_data_list: それに朝休めた分、練習で力を出せる！
choice_data_list_en: Plus, getting some rest this morning means you can give it your all in practice!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Okay. I'm back on my feet. What have
you got for
me today, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shortly after, we manage to find an open
training
facility to use.
